'''B1 electrostaff droids''' were [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] units who often appeared with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] scavengers. They seemed to be a variant from a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], as they are stronger and more agile. They carried [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] and could knock down an opponent with a single blow and going as far as engaging [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]] who carried [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="Kinect" />
